purpose: Gate-batched dh reduction (SPLITG) in the R-tiled backward: qualify it alone and with FUSE=2, race-verify and sanitize it, measure the backward step phases in the kernel (PROF build) at D = 192-768, B = 16, and time the training step against FlashRNN1 (TileLang env B = 16, module env B = 16 and 64) and SPLITG against the previous best candidates
gates: Pre-registered admission of a SPLITG level (g0: SPLITG alone, g2: SPLITG + FUSE=2) to selection: every qualification case of the level passes (grads, modes, repeat; vs_base is not applicable: the gate-batched sum is not bitwise to the per-gate accumulation), its race 'correct' groups are clean and every sanitizer run of the level reports 0 errors. A level that fails is removed from every selection role before selection; the previous candidates (unfused fast + TF32, FUSE=2; qualified in the backward, fix and fused batches) always stay.
criterion: Pre-registered: B = 16 counts as fixed if, in at least one environment, the selected FlashRNN2 training step (role frnn2 = previous + admitted SPLITG candidates)'s 95% interval lower bound against FlashRNN1 is >= 1.0 for every D in 192-768 and both cells; B = 64 must not regress (every shape keeps lower bound >= 1.0). The SPLITG effect is the splitg-vs-prev comparison per shape. Default rule: SPLITG (with the configuration the splitg role selected most often at that width in the TileLang environment, ties to LSTM's) becomes the default for a width D only if splitg-vs-prev has lower bound >= 1.0 at B = 16 in the TileLang environment for both cells; it applies to every batch size if the B = 64 splitg-vs-prev upper bound is >= 1.0 for both cells, otherwise only to B <= 16. The phase profile is reported, not gated; its timer reads perturb the step, and the profiled kernel time is reported next to the unprofiled one.

expected_minutes.basis: the fused batch with the same structure and size took 60 min

node_reason: One H100 node (4 H100): independent single-GPU lanes; no cross-GPU topology needed
